Workflow.Name: Exclude Junior Consultants from ProfessionalSummary requirement
Workflow.Description: ProfessionalSummary is optional only when a consultant has the title "Consultant" and the seniority level "Junior". For all other consultant profiles, a ProfessionalSummary is required.
